# Allowlist for the public-repo leak guard (ci actions/leak-guard, v1.26.0).
# One REGULAR EXPRESSION per line, matched against a finding's TEXT or its
# repository-relative PATH. NO trailing comments — a loader line is a whole
# regex; comments must sit on their own # lines. Blank lines are ignored.
#
# Baseline triaged 2026-10-29 against the full tree (175 findings, dry run with
# the org identifiers from vars); every entry below is a name that is public on
# purpose — the finding-by-finding triage is in the PR that added this file.
# Anything genuinely internal must be FIXED, not added here.

# ── Hostnames ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The product edge hostnames: live/edge, live/identity, live/onprem,
# live/storage-*, live/observability-alerting and the incident/record docs
# configure or name them, and the edge configuration in this public repo is the
# source of truth for them (published deliberately).
^(www|mail|send|preview)\.qnsc\.vn$
^(rova|opshub)(-dev)?\.qnsc\.vn$
^rova\.dev\.qnsc\.vn$
^rova-assets(-dev)?\.qnsc\.vn$
^opshub-api-dev\.qnsc\.vn$
^kb-dev\.qnsc\.vn$
^kb-api-dev\.qnsc\.vn$
# Dead pre-rename name, kept in the EKS teardown record:
^rally-api-dev\.qnsc\.vn$
# Dead EKS hostname, teardown record only:
^rova-api-eks-dev\.qnsc\.vn$
# Example PR-preview hostname in the platform design record:
^rova-412\.preview\.qnsc\.vn$

# ── Mail addresses ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Operator alert alias in live/* and docs (already public by design):
^devops@qnsc\.vn$
# SECURITY.md's public security-contact address:
^security@qnsc\.vn$
# Product send-only mailboxes, both documented spellings (noreply-<product>
# and <product>-noreply):
^noreply(-[a-z0-9-]+)?@qnsc\.vn$
^([a-z0-9]+-)?noreply@qnsc\.vn$

# ── GUIDs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Microsoft well-known constants (public first-party app / tenant ids used by
# the Entra audit scripts and live/identity):
^00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000$
^00000002-0000-0ff1-ce00-000000000000$
^f8cdef31-a31e-4b4a-93e4-5f571e91255a$
# Fabricated fixtures in the owner-script test suites:
^0{8}(-0{4}){3}-0{12}$
^scripts/entra-audit/test_entra_audit\.py$
^scripts/owner/test_aws_orphan_audit\.sh$
# (also that file's operator fixture address)
^scripts/owner/test_bootstrap_state\.sh$
# DEFAULT_ROLE_ID all-zero sentinel:
^scripts/owner/entra-hygiene/hygiene\.py$
# Resource IDENTIFIERS (not credentials) in the incident/record docs — an ACM
# certificate id inside a well-formed ARN and an RDS managed-secret NAME (the
# secret's value is never in the tree; gitleaks owns that):
^c3a479c8-f7b4-4bf1-b26c-998e14a34384$
^72b35adf-eded-4097-b391-02d1319d1e8e$

# ── RFC1918 allocations ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ONLY the VPC subnet CIDRs of the two runtime stacks, file-scoped (policy:
# allowlist by file, never whole directories). Everywhere else a private
# address in the tree fails — allocations.json, the onprem variables example
# and the design records were FIXED in the PR that added this file (literals
# replaced by symbolic references / an RFC 5737 example), not allowlisted.
^live/runtime-dev/main\.tf$
^live/runtime-prod/main\.tf$
